@@U01432@@
I’ve always been treated with the greatest courtesy.

@@U01434@@
What I’m trying to say is:
Have you never thought seriously—

@@U01436@@
It never pays to trifle with women.

@@U01438@@
Oh, why can’t you understand!

@@U01440@@
For that I’m terribly sorry!
But I do understand—
you are kindness itself.

@@U01441@@
(They walk on.)

@@U01443@@
Did you know me again, little angel,
the moment I entered the garden?

@@U01445@@
Didn't you notice?
I lowered my eyes.

@@U01447@@
And you forgive me the liberty I took,
my impudence,
that day you came from the cathedral?

@@U01449@@
I was confused—
it came as a shock.
No one had ever had anything
bad to say about me.
I began asking myself if I'd
translation:
@@U01432@@
我一直受到最礼貌的对待。

@@U01434@@
我想说的是：
你有没有认真想过——

@@U01436@@
戏弄女人是没有好处的。

@@U01438@@
呵呵，你怎么就看不懂呢！

@@U01440@@
为此我深表歉意！
但我确实明白——
你就是善良本身。

@@U01441@@
（他们继续走。）

@@U01443@@
小天使你又认识我了吗
当我进入花园的那一刻？

@@U01445@@
你没注意到吗？
我垂下眼帘。

@@U01447@@
你原谅我的自由，
我的无礼，
那天你从大教堂来？

@@U01449@@
我很困惑——
这让人震惊。
没有人曾经拥有过任何东西
说我不好。
我开始问自己是否
